channel.title: Clive Vanderwagen: Insights
channel.description: Leadership, team dynamics, culture and customer experience.

item.title: What Are You Hungry For?
item.description: Structure, recognition and stimulus: the three psychological hungers every team brings to work, and why customer experience training that only targets behaviour doesn't stick.

item.title: Your customer experience training didn't fail. It aimed at the wrong level.
item.description: Scripts and service standards change what people say for a few weeks. If you want the change to hold, you have to work on what people believe about the customer, and about themselves.

item.title: Culture is not a poster problem
item.description: Values workshops and engagement surveys describe a culture. They don't change one. What changes it is whether people's basic psychological needs are met, every day, by the people leading them.

item.title: The Enneagram is not a team-day party trick
item.description: Used properly, the Enneagram isn't about labelling people. It's about understanding motivation, which is the thing most team interventions never get to.
